nodes.label: Life-Level Fitness RPG
nodes.summary: Core product concept: a mobile platform gamifying physical activity by combining fitness tracker (like Strava), RPG game (like WoW), and social network. Real-world training produces in-game progression.

attributes.rationale: Combines real life + game progression + social competition to make fitness more fun, motivating, and habit-forming. Freemium model: free core features, premium for advanced stats/cosmetics.

nodes.label: XP Engine
nodes.summary: XP calculation system: BaseXP=DurationMinutes×10, DistanceBonus=DistanceKm×50 (running/cycling), CalorieBonus=Calories×0.5, with activity modifiers and stackable multipliers (XP Storm ×2, Streak ×1.5). Formula implemented in ASP.NET Core, never in Flutter client.

attributes.rationale: All game calculations stay server-side to prevent cheating and enable balance changes without app updates.

nodes.label: Activity Deduplication Strategy
nodes.summary: Prevents duplicate activities from multiple sources (HealthKit + Strava + manual). Uses ExternalId field (format: provider:nativeId) on Activity entity, ExternalActivityRecord table with unique constraint on (CharacterId, Provider, ExternalId), and partial unique index. Manual logs have no ExternalId.

attributes.rationale: Same workout could arrive via HealthKit AND Strava AND manual log. Dedup at the backend prevents double XP grants while allowing intentional duplicates from manual logging.

nodes.label: Supabase as Infrastructure Only
nodes.summary: Architecture decision: Supabase used only for managed PostgreSQL and file storage connected via EF Core. All auth (JWT), game logic, XP calculations, and business rules live exclusively in ASP.NET Core. Supabase Auth is not used.

attributes.rationale: Avoids mixing two auth systems while benefiting from Supabase's managed infrastructure at no extra cost on the free tier.

nodes.label: Character System
nodes.summary: RPG character with 5 core stats (STR, END, AGI, FLX, STA), Level, XP, Rank, Titles, Class. Stats grow from real workouts via activity-to-stat mapping. Stored in Domain/Entities/Character.cs.

nodes.label: Adventure Map
nodes.summary: SVG-based RPG map where player moves via real activity distance (1km≈1day travel). Regions: Forest of Endurance, Mountains of Strength, Ocean of Balance. Branching paths, crossroads, mini-boss blockers.

nodes.label: Boss & Challenge System
nodes.summary: Three boss types: Regular (7-day, zone travel required), Mini-Boss (3-day, no travel), Guild Raids (shared HP pool, all members contribute damage, boss regenerates if members slack). Top damage dealer gets bonus XP.

nodes.label: Strava OAuth2 Flow
nodes.summary: OAuth2 connect flow via flutter_web_auth_2: user taps Connect Strava, in-app browser opens Strava auth, redirect to lifelevel://oauth/strava deep link, Flutter POSTs code to backend, backend exchanges for tokens (never stored client-side), stores encrypted in StravaConnection entity.

attributes.rationale: OAuth code never stored client-side — secret stays on backend for security.

nodes.label: Health Package Pull Sync
nodes.summary: Single Flutter health package handles both HealthKit (iOS) and Health Connect/Google Fit (Android). Always a pull model: app pulls workouts since lastSyncTime. Sync triggers: app foreground resume (15min throttle), manual Sync Now button, startup before home screen.

attributes.rationale: No background process for MVP simplicity. Health package unifies both platforms with one Dart API.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture Principle
nodes.summary: Outer layers depend on inner layers; inner layers never depend on outer layers. Domain → Application → Infrastructure/Presentation. Domain has no dependency on ASP.NET Core or EF Core.

attributes.rationale: Keeps business logic independent from frameworks, improves testability, reduces coupling, supports long-term maintainability.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith Architecture
nodes.summary: Backend is a modular monolith with ports and adapters. LifeLevel.Api is the composition root (controllers, DI, EF migrations, seeders, hosted jobs). Business logic in modules. SharedKernel for contracts, ports, events. Single AppDbContext in LifeLevel.Api.

attributes.rationale: Modular monolith allows clear module boundaries and future extraction to microservices without premature distributed system complexity.

nodes.label: IActivityLogPort
nodes.summary: SharedKernel port interface for logging external activities. Method: LogExternalActivityAsync(userId, type, durationMinutes, distanceKm, calories, heartRateAvg, externalId, performedAt, ct). ActivityService implements this interface. Allows Integrations module to use Activity module without direct service injection.

attributes.rationale: Cross-module communication via SharedKernel port to avoid dependency cycles between Integrations module and Activity module.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith + Ports & Adapters Pattern
nodes.summary: Architectural pattern chosen to give each business domain its own project with explicit contracts while keeping a single deployable binary and database.

attributes.rationale: Single deployable keeps deployment simple at MVP; clean module boundaries allow future microservice extraction without architectural rethink

nodes.label: WorldZone vs Map Concept
nodes.summary: WorldZone is the overworld layer (named regions, zone graph). Map is the dungeon instance layer within a zone (node/edge graph with Boss, Chest, DungeonPortal, Crossroads encounters). Kept as separate modules to avoid coupling.

nodes.label: In-Process Domain Events Pattern
nodes.summary: IDomainEvent/IEventHandler/IEventPublisher interfaces in SharedKernel. InProcessEventPublisher resolves handlers from DI. Used for side effects that don't affect the response.

attributes.rationale: Avoids dependency cycles while enabling side-effect-driven module communication without MediatR overhead at MVP
attributes.known_limitation: In-process delivery not guaranteed; handler failure after DB save silently loses event

nodes.label: Single AppDbContext Strategy
nodes.summary: One AppDbContext in LifeLevel.Api with per-module IEntityTypeConfiguration applied via ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly.

attributes.rationale: Cross-module FKs require shared context at MVP stage; mechanical refactor path available post-MVP

nodes.label: MapService Stays in LifeLevel.Api
nodes.summary: MapService intentionally remains in LifeLevel.Api because it loads Boss/Chest/DungeonPortal/Crossroads entities from multiple Adventure modules by NodeId.

attributes.rationale: Cycle prevention: Map module must not depend on Adventure modules

nodes.label: Marketing and Positioning
nodes.summary: Honest self-audit of Life-Level's competitive position. Identifies strengths (depth as defensive moat, no pay-to-win, behavior reframing), weaknesses (content production cost, no coaching layer, tracker dependency, dark aesthetic, iOS deferred), and the unique wedge: deep MMO-grade progression where the grind IS the workout and progress is public identity.

attributes.key_weakness: content production cost and iOS deferred
attributes.unique_wedge: MMO-depth progression + fitness specificity + public identity

nodes.label: Product Vision
nodes.summary: Core product vision: fitness tracker + RPG game + social network fused into one. Freemium business model (free=core, premium=cosmetic/convenience). Psychological retention levers: variable reward, streaks, rank prestige, social comparison, delayed gratification. Non-goals: not medical, not coaching, not hardcore sim.

attributes.tagline: Train in the real world → progress in a game world

nodes.label: Roadmap Status
nodes.summary: Phase-by-phase implementation status as of 2026-04-17. Phases 0-6 complete, Phase 7 partial (XP Storm flag but no multiplier, Wandering Merchants not started, Seasonal Events design only), Phase 8 in progress with push notifications and social features.

nodes.label: Achievements and Titles
nodes.summary: Documents 48 achievements across 5 tiers (Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic/Legendary) and 5 categories (Exploration/Combat/Social/Fitness/Gameplay). Rank ladder (Novice→Warrior→Champion→Legendary) based on bosses defeated. Titles are equippable cosmetic badges granted by TitleService after milestone events.

nodes.label: Activity System
nodes.summary: Defines 8 activity types (Running, Cycling, Gym, Yoga, Swimming, Hiking, Walking, Climbing) each with stat gain mappings, XP multipliers, and optional distance bonuses. Four logging channels: manual, Health Connect, Strava webhook, Garmin OAuth. External dedup via ExternalId.

nodes.label: Adventure Map and World
nodes.summary: Two-tier exploration: overworld WorldZones (Forest of Endurance, Mountains of Strength, Ocean of Balance) and dungeon-layer MapNode graphs. Distance-based travel mechanic. Node types: Boss, Chest, DungeonPortal, Crossroads. MapService stays in composition root to avoid dependency cycles.

nodes.label: Boss System
nodes.summary: Three boss types: Regular (7-day timer, travel required, single-player), Mini-boss (3-day timer, fight anywhere), Guild Raid (design only). Damage formula: (duration×2 + distance×10 + calories/5) × activityMultiplier. Boss defeats advance rank ladder via TitleService.

nodes.label: Character System
nodes.summary: RPG character with Level, XP, Rank, Class, Title, and 5 core stats (STR/END/AGI/FLX/STA capped at 100). Inventory slots scale with level (20-100). Starter bonus 500 XP. Rank advances based on bosses defeated.

nodes.label: Items and Equipment
nodes.summary: 5 rarity tiers (Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic/Legendary), 5 equipment slots (Head/Chest/Hands/Feet/Accessory). Items give XP % bonus and stat bonuses via IGearBonusReadPort. Drop rules via ItemDropRule entity. ItemGrantService handles drops; InventoryFullOverlay shown when at capacity.

nodes.label: Login Rewards
nodes.summary: 7-day repeating login reward cycle: Days 1-6 award 50-200 XP; Day 3 adds streak shield; Day 7 awards 300 XP + XP Storm flag. Midnight UTC reset via DailyResetJob. MainShell shows LoginRewardScreen dialog on app resume when reward is available.

nodes.label: LL-001: Wire XP Storm Multiplier
nodes.summary: In-progress backend ticket to wire XP Storm ×2 multiplier into ActivityService.LogActivityAsync. Multiplier applied after gear bonus. Requires unit tests and LogActivityResult exposure of storm flag.

nodes.summary: Bug ticket: character doesn't move and zone progress bar stuck at 0. Root cause was missing IWorldZoneDistancePort. Multiple implementation passes including full redesign per zone-click-progress.html mockup.

nodes.label: LL-012: Seasonal Events Implementation
nodes.summary: Backlog ticket for implementing seasonal events with Season, SeasonReward, UserSeasonProgress entities, global ×2 XP multiplier, event-scoped leaderboard, and mobile event banner + reward-ladder widget.

nodes.label: LL-013: Push Notifications via FCM

nodes.label: LL-011: Wandering Merchants Random Event

nodes.norm_label: ll-016: guild system + shared-hp raid boss

nodes.label: Quest System
nodes.summary: Time-boxed objectives auto-updated on activity log. Three types: Daily (5/day, +300 XP bonus), Weekly (3), Special (unlimited). Categories: duration, calories, distance, workouts, streak, login. Progress update flow publishes QuestCompletedEvent and AllDailyQuestsCompletedEvent.

nodes.label: Random Events
nodes.summary: Spontaneous game events: Treasure Chests (live, persistent MapNode type), XP Storms (partial - flag exists, multiplier not applied), Wandering Merchants (Phase 7, not implemented). XP Storm stacks ×2 with streak ×1.5 = ×3 total.

nodes.label: Seasonal Events
nodes.summary: Design-only. Limited-time themed challenges with 5-stage reward ladder, ×2 XP, event leaderboard, exclusive cosmetics. Planned module LifeLevel.Modules.Seasons. Phase 7 target.

nodes.label: Streak System
nodes.summary: Tracks consecutive activity days. Shield mechanism allows skipping 1 day per 7 without penalty. Shields awarded every 7 TotalDaysActive. DailyResetJob breaks expired streaks at midnight UTC. ×1.5 XP multiplier (Phase 7 target).

nodes.label: XP and Leveling
nodes.summary: Universal progression currency. XP curve: level*(level-1)/2*300. Base XP from duration*3 + type multiplier + distance bonus + calories/10 + gear bonus. XP sources: activities, quests, daily bonus, login reward, zone discovery, boss defeat, chest, dungeon, crossroads, achievements.

nodes.label: API Endpoints
nodes.summary: 16 controllers, all [Authorize] unless noted. Covers auth, character, classes, activity, quests, streak, login-reward, world zones, map, boss, chest, dungeon, crossroads, items, achievements, titles, users, integrations, and admin controllers.

nodes.label: AppDbContext and Persistence
nodes.summary: Single EF Core DbContext shared across all modules with 41 DbSets. OnModelCreating applies configurations from all module assemblies then configures cross-module FKs inline. PostgreSQL via Npgsql. One migrations project strategy.

attributes.rationale: Single DbContext for MVP to support cross-module FKs without fragmenting migrations

nodes.label: Architecture Overview
nodes.summary: Modular monolith with Ports & Adapters. Single deployable, 13 module class libraries + SharedKernel. No cycles in dependency DAG. Cross-module communication: Tier 1 (sync port calls) and Tier 2 (in-process domain events after DB save). Known MVP limitation: in-process events not guaranteed.

attributes.rationale: Single deployable for simpler MVP ops; clean boundaries allow future microservice extraction

nodes.label: Auth and JWT
nodes.summary: Stateless JWT bearer tokens, BCrypt password hashing, 24-hour lifetime, HMAC-SHA256. IUserContext resolves current user from HTTP context. Admin role via User.Role enum. Mobile stores token in FlutterSecureStorage.

nodes.label: Cross-Module Events
nodes.summary: In-process domain events via InProcessEventPublisher. Events: UserRegisteredEvent, CharacterLeveledUpEvent, ActivityLoggedEvent, QuestCompletedEvent, AllDailyQuestsCompletedEvent, StreakBrokenEvent. Runs AFTER DB save - not guaranteed delivery at MVP.

nodes.label: DailyResetJob
nodes.summary: IHostedService running at midnight UTC. Breaks expired streaks (CheckAndBreakExpiredStreaksAsync), resets ShieldUsedToday flags, resets LoginReward ClaimedToday flags. Uses IStreakDailyReset and ILoginRewardDailyReset ports.

nodes.label: Seeders
nodes.summary: Idempotent seed data in LifeLevel.Api composition root. WorldSeeder (worlds, zones, map nodes, bosses, chests, dungeons, crossroads), ItemSeeder (21 items + drop rules), AchievementSeeder (48 achievements), TitleSeeder (title templates).

nodes.label: SharedKernel
nodes.summary: Contracts-only module. Contains IUserContext, ICurrentClock, Result<T>, domain event interfaces, InProcessEventPublisher, and all cross-module port interfaces. No dependencies on other modules.

nodes.label: Achievements Module
nodes.summary: Evaluates 48 achievement conditions (BossesFought, StreakDaysAtOnce, TotalQuestsCompleted, TotalActivities, TotalDistanceKm etc.) and awards XP on first unlock. Not yet auto-triggered - Phase 7 target.

nodes.label: Activity Module
nodes.summary: Owns workout log. LogActivityAsync computes XP + stat gains, applies gear bonus, inserts Activity row, awards XP, applies stat gains, publishes ActivityLoggedEvent, adds map distance, advances quests. Supports external activity ingestion for Strava/Garmin/HealthConnect.

nodes.label: Adventure.Dungeons Module
nodes.summary: Owns multi-floor dungeons and branching crossroads as map encounter nodes. DungeonService handles enter/advance-floor/complete. CrossroadsService handles path choice, teleports user, awards XP.

nodes.label: Adventure.Encounters Module
nodes.summary: Owns Bosses and Chests as map point encounters. BossService handles activate/damage/defeat with timer system. ChestService validates proximity and opens with item drops. Both award XP via ICharacterXpPort.

nodes.label: Character Module
nodes.summary: Heart of the game. Owns character stats, XP, level, rank, class, titles, XP history. CharacterService implements 6 ports. TitleService grants titles on level-up. CharacterCreatedHandler creates initial character on UserRegisteredEvent.

nodes.label: Identity Module
nodes.summary: Owns User record, authentication (BCrypt + JWT), and UserRingItem cosmetic collection for radial FAB. AuthService registers/logins users. Publishes UserRegisteredEvent on registration.

nodes.label: Integrations Module
nodes.summary: Connects to Strava (OAuth + webhooks), Garmin (OAuth 2.0 + PKCE), and Health Connect batch sync. ExternalActivityRecord deduplicates incoming activities. Strava Client ID 218444.

nodes.label: Items Module
nodes.summary: Owns item catalog (21 items), character inventory, equipment slots (5), and drop rules. ItemService computes aggregated gear bonus. ItemGrantService evaluates drop rules after boss/chest/dungeon completion. Strava Sync Badge auto-granted on first Strava connect.

nodes.label: LoginReward Module
nodes.summary: Owns 7-day daily login reward cycle. Day 3 grants streak shield, Day 7 gives 300 XP + XP Storm flag. ClaimDailyRewardAsync awards XP and optionally adds shield. DailyResetJob resets ClaimedToday flags at midnight.

nodes.label: Map Module (Backend)
nodes.summary: Dungeon-layer graph module. Owns MapNode, MapEdge, UserMapProgress, UserNodeUnlock entities. No service — orchestration lives in LifeLevel.Api/Application/Services/MapService.cs. Exposes ports for distance tracking and node counts. Travel mechanic: user picks destination, activity adds distance, arrival unlocks node.

nodes.label: Quest Module (Backend)
nodes.summary: Owns daily/weekly/special quest templates and user progress. QuestService generates quests per user, advances progress on activity logs, awards 300-XP all-5-dailies bonus. Raises QuestCompletedEvent and AllDailyQuestsCompletedEvent.

nodes.label: Streak Module (Backend)
nodes.summary: Tracks consecutive activity days per user. Awards shields every 7 days (TotalDaysActive % 7). Shield can bridge a 2-day gap. Midnight job breaks expired streaks. Raises StreakBrokenEvent.

nodes.label: WorldZone Module (Backend)
nodes.summary: Overworld layer — graph of named regions (World, WorldZone, WorldZoneEdge). Users move between zones by spending real-world distance. First-time zone arrival awards TotalXp. Crossroads zones teleport instantly. Seeded by WorldSeeder.

nodes.label: App Architecture (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Flutter app entry point. _AuthGate routes to LoginScreen, WelcomeSetupScreen, or MainShell based on JWT token and character setup state. MainShell owns tabs, radial FAB, global overlays (LevelUp, ItemObtained, InventoryFull, LoginReward), deep link handling, connectivity, and lifecycle.

nodes.label: Core Infrastructure (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Everything in lib/core/. ApiClient is a static Dio singleton with JWT interceptor and 401-redirect. AppTheme.dark uses Material 3. Core services are broadcast StreamController singletons (LevelUpNotifier, ItemObtainedNotifier, etc). Core widgets include global overlays shown by MainShell.

nodes.label: Flutter Dependencies (pubspec)
nodes.summary: Key packages: dio (HTTP), flutter_riverpod (state), flutter_secure_storage (JWT), health (Health Connect/HealthKit), app_links (deep links), go_router (pulled in but unused), lottie (animations), flutter_svg (SVG), connectivity_plus (offline detection).

todo: crypto package for Garmin PKCE SHA-256

nodes.label: Global Event Pattern (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Six broadcast StreamController singletons decouple cross-feature signalling from Riverpod. LevelUpNotifier, ItemObtainedNotifier, InventoryFullNotifier (fired by features), NavTabNotifier, MapTabNotifier, WorldZoneRefreshNotifier (navigation/refresh signals). MainShell is the single listener for overlays.

attributes.rationale: One-shot UI events do not fit Riverpod state; need cross-feature signalling without context or callbacks

nodes.label: Routing and Deep Links (Mobile)
nodes.summary: No GoRouter — stateful shell with IndexedStack tabs and Navigator.push for secondary screens. Deep links use lifelevel:// scheme for Strava/Garmin OAuth callbacks via AppLinks stream. Android singleTop+taskAffinity prevents double-fire bug. 401 → ApiClient clears token and redirects to LoginScreen via global navigatorKey.

nodes.label: Shell and Radial FAB (Mobile)
nodes.summary: MainShell hosts bottom tab bar with centre FAB expanding into radial menu of 6 orbiting items. 10 ring items available (World, Guild, Stats, Battle, Titles, Boss, Profile, Leaderboard, Map, Quests); 4 nav tabs default. Ring is draggable/snappable. Long-press FAB → CustomizeRingSheet. Ring config saved server-side.

nodes.label: State Management (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Riverpod 2.x. AsyncNotifierProvider for long-lived mutable state, FutureProvider for read-only async, NotifierProvider for sync mutable. Provider invalidation on reconnect and after activity log. CharacterNotifier fires LevelUpNotifier on level delta.

nodes.label: Feature - Achievements (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Achievement list in Profile → Achievements tab. AchievementDto with tier (Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic/Legendary), progress tracking, XP reward. AchievementsService calls GET /api/achievements and POST /api/achievements/check-unlocks. achievementsProvider is FutureProvider.

nodes.label: Feature - Activity (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Manual activity logging form (8 types) and history screen. LogActivityResult triggers LevelUpNotifier, ItemObtainedNotifier, InventoryFullNotifier, and invalidates character/quests/activity/streak/map providers. ActivityService calls POST /api/activity/log and GET /api/activity/history.

nodes.label: Feature - Auth (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Login, registration, and first-time character setup wizard (5 screens). AuthService handles login/register, saves JWT via ApiClient.saveToken. Character setup wizard calls CharacterService.setupCharacter → +500 XP starter bonus. AuthService.saveRingConfig saves radial ring selection.

nodes.label: Feature - Boss (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Boss list (Active/Defeated/Locked/Expired states) and BossBattleScreen. BossListItem model tracks HP, timer, damage dealt. BossPageService calls GET /api/boss. bossListProvider is AsyncNotifierProvider with refresh(). Opened from radial FAB Boss item.

nodes.label: Feature - Character (Mobile)
nodes.summary: CharacterProfile model (stats, XP, rank, weekly data, gear bonuses). CharacterService calls GET /api/character/me, xp-history, spend-stat. CharacterNotifier fires LevelUpNotifier on level delta. xpHistoryProvider uses FutureProvider.autoDispose for fresh refetch.

nodes.label: Feature - Home (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Main dashboard tab. Cards: HomeHeader, HomeXpCard, HomeStreakCard, HomeQuestsCard, HomeLastActivityCard, HomeStatsRow, HomeBossCard, HomeMapProgressSection. mapJourneyProvider (FutureProvider) powers map progress section. Refreshes on tab switch.

nodes.label: Feature - Integrations (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Health Connect, Strava, Garmin integration screen. HealthSyncService reads workouts via health package. StravaService/GarminService handle OAuth via url_launcher + AppLinks deep links. IntegrationSyncNotifier (NotifierProvider) manages sync state. Foreground auto-sync on app resume (>15 min elapsed).

known_issues: MIUI Health Connect permission dialog fails

nodes.label: Feature - Items (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Equipment paperdoll + inventory grid. ItemDto with rarity, slot type, stat/XP bonuses. ItemsService handles equip/unequip/inventory. equipmentProvider and inventoryProvider are AsyncNotifierProviders. Inventory 70% full → yellow warning; 100% → InventoryFullNotifier fires.

nodes.label: Feature - Login Reward (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Dialog shown on app resume when daily reward available. LoginRewardStatus tracks day-in-cycle (1-7), shield inclusion, XP Storm flag (Day 7). Claim fires LevelUpNotifier if leveled up. MainShell triggers via CharacterProfile.loginRewardAvailable.

nodes.label: Feature - Map (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Two CustomPainter map canvases: MapScreen (dungeon layer, nodes in current zone) and WorldMapScreen (overworld). MapService calls GET /api/map/full and PUT /api/map/destination. Node types have dedicated bottom sheets (Boss/Chest/Dungeon/Crossroads). Admin debug panel included.

nodes.label: Feature - Profile (Mobile)
nodes.summary: Tabbed screen: Overview (XP bar, stat cards, activity summary), Equipment (paperdoll), Inventory (grid), Achievements, Admin (JWT role-gated). Settings sheet links to Integrations + Logout. profile_stat_metadata.dart holds StatMeta for all 5 stats.

nodes.label: Feature - Quests
nodes.summary: Quests feature: three tabs (Daily/Weekly/Special) with quest cards, progress bars, XP rewards, and daily bonus banner. Contains file structure, models, service, provider, and widget documentation.

nodes.label: Feature - Streak
nodes.summary: Streak data provider with use-shield action. Displayed on home header, home streak card, and profile overview. No dedicated screen.

nodes.label: Feature - Titles
